text.zh-TW: 確認船班或島間航班的時刻、天候停駛時怎麼處理
text.en: Confirm boat or inter-island flight times and what happens when weather cancels them

text.zh-TW: 確認潛水或浮潛的預訂、證照要求與天候取消政策
text.en: Confirm diving or snorkelling bookings, certification needed and the weather policy

text.zh-TW: 確認目的地有沒有環境稅或入境費（例如帛琉的 Pristine Paradise Environmental Fee），怎麼收
text.en: Confirm any environment or entry fee (e.g. Palau's Pristine Paradise Environmental Fee) and how it is collected

text.zh-TW: 確認潛水後到搭機要隔多久（問潛水中心），排在行程裡
text.en: Confirm with the dive centre how long to wait between diving and flying, and plan for it

text.zh-TW: 確認目的地對防曬乳成分有沒有限制
text.en: Confirm whether the destination restricts sunscreen ingredients

text.zh-TW: 確認外島能不能刷卡、要帶多少現金，當地用什麼幣別
text.en: Confirm whether outer islands take cards, how much cash to bring and in which currency

text.zh-TW: 確認度假村是否含餐（記帳時餐飲可標「已含」）
text.en: Confirm whether the resort includes meals
